title: Comment "Design" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just killed graphic designers
description: Comment "Design" and I'll send you the full guide 👇 Claude just killed graphic designers. You can now design anything you want directly inside Claude's new Design feature. Here's how it works: Open the Claude desktop app Click Design in the bottom left corner Describe what you want I said: "Build me an interactive 3D solar system where I can click on each planet and see all its facts." Claude built the entire thing in 3 minutes and it's fully interactive. You can generate: • Presentations • Posters and social media graphics • Working prototypes • Animations and documents Everything is fully customizable. You can even import from Figma or export into Canva or Claude Code. Designers charge thousands for stuff like this. Claude does it for free. #ai #claude #claudedesign #design #aitools
